tasks.title: Define the project health contract
tasks.objective: Specify the response shape shared by the health endpoint and its status page.
acceptance_criteria: The contract defines status, service name and a UTC observation timestamp.
Example healthy and unavailable responses are documented.

tasks.title: Implement the health endpoint
tasks.objective: Expose the agreed health contract through an HTTP endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: The endpoint returns a response matching the agreed contract.
Tests cover healthy and unavailable service responses.

tasks.title: Implement the status page
tasks.objective: Display the agreed health contract with clear loading and unavailable states.
acceptance_criteria: The page renders healthy and unavailable contract examples.
Loading and failed requests have distinct visible states.

tasks.title: Verify the connected health experience
tasks.objective: Connect the page to the endpoint and verify the combined user experience.
acceptance_criteria: An integration check verifies the page displays the endpoint's service status.
The combined changes pass the project's required verification checks.
